## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) ↓ falling (CORRECTION) and SPY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND support risk appetite.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Commodity/energy strength: XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND driving cyclicals. Credit watch: Credit Spread (Level: 0.7259 | 1W: +0.19% | 1M: -0.83%) → flat | RECOVERY while HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.35%) ABOVE TREND shows calm but monitor.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar firming: UUP (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -0.66%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY. Long duration steady: TLT (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +2.80%) ABOVE TREND keeping tails softened.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy and Utilities leading: XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND, XLU (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +7.69%) ABOVE TREND; Materials and Industrials showing strength via XLB (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND and XLI (1W: +2.22% | 1M: +8.31%) ABOVE TREND. Tech mixed: XLK (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY — style: cyclicals/value nudging growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US leadership intact: SPY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND versus EEM (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND showing EM catch-up. China mixed: FXI (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -1.35%) RECOVERY while EWJ (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +7.89%) CORRECTION.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation present but selective: IWM (1W: +1.95% | 1M: -1.19%) RECOVERY and ARKK (1W: +4.44% | 1M: -10.96%) RECOVERY show short-term interest; IBIT (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -24.83%) RECOVERY signals continued dispersion.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial/metal strength: CPER (1W: +1.86% | 1M: +1.37%) ABOVE TREND. Gold strong: GLD (1W: +3.82% | 1M: +5.64%) ABOVE TREND while SLV (1W: +13.13% | 1M: -8.74%) RECOVERY is volatile.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy outperforming: XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas weak: UNG (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Broad sector breadth (9/11) and SPY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +0.59%) ABOVE TREND confirm cyclical tilt. Divergence: XLK (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY and several 1W/1M mismatches (e.g., ARKK, IBIT, EWJ) constitute a MINOR divergence — monitor but not regime-breaking.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and commodities exposure via XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND and XLB (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to idiosyncratic small-cap/tech dispersion given Small vs Large (Level: 0.3838 | 1W: -0.49% | 1M: -1.98%) → flat | BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND and Materials XLB (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Tech XLK (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY and Natural Gas UNG (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Brent BNO (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND and Copper CPER (1W: +1.86% | 1M: +1.37%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Silver SLV (1W: +13.13% | 1M: -8.74%) RECOVERY remains swingy and UNG (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (read for complacency); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot); Tech vs Financials level Tech/Fin 2.6839 (watch rotation pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Energy, Utilities and select Commodities showing relative strength. Key risk: credit-signal noise (Credit Spread Level: 0.7259 | 1W: +0.19% | 1M: -0.83%) → flat and tech 1M weakness (XLK (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%) RECOVERY) are divergences to monitor.
